crossRefs.note: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up;’
yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God;’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions, and that we…
He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

translations.web: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
translations.bsb: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
translations.kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
translations.asv: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;
